partial_coverage.Base and Compiler: Bootstrap foundation targets; full upstream suites are not yet ported.
partial_coverage.Pkg: Miscellaneous/lifecycle suite, precompile skip/force controls and extension suppression, plus a real package REPL using a local versioned registry; full resolver and registry suites are not yet ported.
partial_coverage.REPL: Styled PTY startup, backspace, completion, package add/status/test and package loading; full REPL suite is not yet ported.
partial_coverage.LinearAlgebra: Dense multiplication in the package lifecycle fixture; factorizations and the full suite are not certified.
partial_coverage.Other stdlibs and ecosystem packages: Build/precompilation only unless exercised by the named suites; not certified.
partial_coverage.Revise-based tests: Blocked by unported JuliaInterpreter and LoweredCodeUtils; CI uses the ordinary test runner.
